title: Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals
abstract: arXiv:2610.23012v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have significantly improved the ability to operate real-world software through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using visual observations and natural language instructions. However, maintaining strong performance on unseen applications remains challenging, as practical tasks often require long-horizon procedural knowledge and application-specific operation patterns. In addition, constructing executable tasks and collecting corresponding trajectories for training still heavily rely on human-annotated data, incurring substantial cost. In this paper, we propose MAGE (Manual-augmented computer use AGent Execution and learning), a framework that leverages user manuals as a scalable source of procedural knowledge to improve both inference and training. translated_title: 基于用户手册的计算机使用智能体对新软件的适应
translated_abstract: 多模态基础模型的最新进展显著提升了通过图形用户界面（GUI）、利用视觉观察和自然语言指令来操作真实世界软件的能力。然而，在未见过的应用上保持强大的性能仍然具有挑战性，因为实际任务通常需要长程的程序性知识和特定于应用的操作模式。此外，构建可执行任务以及收集用于训练的相应轨迹仍然严重依赖人工标注数据，导致成本高昂。在本文中，我们提出了MAGE（基于手册增强的计算机使用智能体执行与学习），这是一个利用用户手册作为可扩展的程序性知识来源、同时改进推理与训练的框架。在执行过程中，MAGE检索与任务相关的手册内容，并使用规划器为计算机使用智能体（CUA）生成明确的程序性指导。
tldr: 本文提出MAGE框架，将用户手册作为可扩展的程序性知识来源，在执行时检索任务相关手册内容并生成明确的程序性指导，从而提升计算机使用智能体适应新软件的能力。
en_tdlr: MAGE is a framework that leverages user manuals as a scalable source of procedural knowledge, retrieving task-relevant manual content and generating explicit procedural guidance to help computer use agents adapt to new software during both inference and training.
